title: Zerostack – A Unix-inspired coding agent written in pure Rust
summary: Zerostack is a coding agent built entirely in Rust, drawing inspiration from Unix philosophy to create modular, composable, and pipeline-friendly AI-assisted coding tools. Published on crates.io, it represents a fresh approach to AI coding assistants with strong emphasis on performance, small tools philosophy, and system-level integration.
problem_solved: Provides a high-performance, composable alternative to traditional AI coding agents by applying Unix principles (small tools, single responsibility, pipe-and-filter patterns) to AI-assisted development.
why_valuable: Rust guarantees memory safety and performance while Unix-inspired design enables powerful scripting, composability, and integration with existing command-line workflows, making it ideal for developers who prefer terminal-centric environments.
